clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Podrig's Order calls for fresh weapons from the Undercity.

Deathguard Podrig found the Sepulcher's stores mostly adequate after an inventory ordered by Executor Hadrec. Replacement weapons were running desperately low. His dispatch lists the blades and arms needed by the Deathguards holding the outpost in Silverpine Forest, a frontier threatened by the Scourge, feral beasts, and other dangers.

The order goes to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, because the damp crypts of Silverpine make forging weapons difficult. Couriers carry the document to bat master Karos Razok, using Forsaken flight paths to speed the shipment from the capital.
